title: 第5章 边缘OB第6章 一个大胆的想法
slug: 这个主角明明很强却异常谨慎
content_zh:
前方传来打斗声。
且听战斗的声音不断靠近自己方向。
有危险！
躲起来。
郑拓很熟练的找到一颗老树，躲了上去。
同时，为了以防万一。
拿出十枚掩息灵符贴在身上。
屏住呼吸。
望着从远方而来的战斗。
“大家不要乱，将妖狼围在中间，寻找破绽在攻击。”
李俊身材修长，手持银白仙剑，宛若一代绝世强者，指挥着十几人围攻一头妖狼。
“嗷……”
妖狼强横无比，起码有二阶妖兽的实力。
在人群之中，宛若荒古神兽，无人可挡。
好在李俊实力不弱，炼气二阶，在加上周围人辅助，与妖狼打的不可开交。
妖兽天生强大。
同级别妖兽可以说完爆人族修仙者。
双方打的异常凶猛。
其中不少人都已挂彩，鲜血哗哗如流水，看的郑拓直呲牙。
太不谨慎，太不谨慎。

虽有李俊主攻，其他人辅佐。
但二阶妖狼毕竟是二阶妖狼。
岂是你们可以对抗的存在。
要是自己，估计早就跑了。
打赢了撑死吃顿肉，打输了小命就没了。
这么简单的道理都不懂，还修什么仙，回家养猪算了。
郑拓心里吐槽。
当然，他除了是忍不住外。
更多的原因是因为对方将危险带到自己身边。
他这么惜命的一个人，怎么可能将自己置身于如此危险的境地。
好在。
战斗并未持续多久。
李俊使出杀手锏，强行用掉两张三品攻击灵符，干掉了妖狼。
以炼气二阶的实力使用三阶灵符，对李俊来说负荷不小。
同时，也代表这孙子天赋极高。
要知道，贸然使用超出自身等级的灵符，特别是攻击型灵符，很容易遭到反噬。
轻者重伤，重者股骨头坏死，晚期就是植物人。
当然，除非你天赋异禀。
如李俊这般。
二阶实力使用三阶灵符，所消耗的仅仅是部分体力与精气罢了。

干掉妖狼，解除危险。
李俊手持一枚银白匕首，来到妖狼尸体前。
三下五除二，从妖狼腹中取出一枚妖丹。
妖丹为妖兽修行根本所在，如人的金丹一样，储存有妖兽所有精华。
content_en:
There were sounds of fighting ahead.
Listen to the sound of fighting coming closer to your direction.
There is danger!
Hide.
Zheng Tuo skillfully found an old tree and hid in it.
Also, just in case.
Take out ten breath-covering charms and stick them on your body.
Hold your breath.
Looking at the battle coming from afar.
"Everyone, don't mess around. Surround the demon wolf in the middle and look for weaknesses to attack."
Li Jun has a slender figure and holds a silver-white fairy sword. He looks like a peerless strongman, commanding more than a dozen people to besiege a demon wolf.
"Ouch..."
The demon wolf is extremely powerful, at least as strong as a second-level demon beast.
Among the crowd, he looked like an ancient beast, unstoppable.
Fortunately, Li Jun was not weak. He was at the second level of Qi Refining, and with the help of the people around him, he was able to fight the demon wolf very well.
Monsters are naturally powerful.
Monsters of the same level can overwhelm human immortal cultivators.
The two sides fought extremely fiercely.
Many of them were already wounded, and their blood was flowing like water. Zheng Tuo bared his teeth when he saw it.
Too careless, too careless.
Although Li Jun was the main attacker, others assisted.
But the second-order demon wolf is a second-order demon wolf after all.
Is this an existence that you can fight against?
If it were him, he would have run away long ago.
If you win, you will have to eat a meal to survive, but if you lose, your life will be gone.
If you don’t understand such a simple truth, why should you become an immortal? Just go home and raise pigs.
Zheng Tuo complained in his heart.
Of course, he couldn't help it.
The more reason is because the other party brings danger to themselves.
How could a person who cherished his life so much put himself in such a dangerous situation.
Good thing.
The battle did not last long.
Li Jun used his trump card and forcibly used two third-grade attack talismans to kill the demon wolf.
Using the third-level spiritual talisman with the strength of the second-level Qi Refining is a heavy load for Li Jun.
At the same time, it also means that this grandson is extremely talented.
You must know that rashly using spiritual talismans beyond your own level, especially offensive talismans, can easily lead to backlash.
In mild cases, severe injuries occur; in severe cases, femoral head necrosis occurs, and in the advanced stage, the patient becomes a vegetative state.
Unless, of course, you are extremely talented.
Like Li Jun.
The second-level strength uses the third-level spiritual talisman, which only consumes part of the physical strength and energy.
Kill the demon wolf and eliminate the danger.
Li Jun held a silver dagger and came to the body of the demon wolf.
After three strokes and five divisions, a demon pill was taken out from the belly of the demon wolf.
The demon elixir is the foundation for the cultivation of demon beasts. Just like a human's golden elixir, it stores all the essence of demon beasts.
